_about: Shame words (safety rule 5) that app text and coach replies must never use. Shared by the app's locale tests (app/src/i18n/__tests__/i18n.parity.test.ts) and the coach output checker (coach/app/output_checker.py). en entries are regular-expression fragments matched on word boundaries, case-insensitive; write fragments that work the same in JavaScript and Python. si/ta entries are plain substrings in Sinhala/Tamil script. Keep si/ta entries specific: a broad stem (e.g. Tamil தோற்ற, which also means 'appearance') would block kind text. The coach builds its whole shame check (en, si, ta) from this file; a plain denial such as "you're not weak" is allowed there, see coach/app/output_checker.py.
